Every patient gets one person who knows them

A certified care partner, assigned 1:1, who gets to know each patient month after month. No hiring, no training, no new headcount for your practice.

Who are Medsien's care partners?

Certified medical assistants who follow each doctor's care preferences and stay with the same patients every month.

How often do they reach my patients?

Every month, by phone call, text or the mobile app.

What happens when something needs a provider?

It goes to your team through a structured escalation process, and every interaction is logged in your EHR.

Measurable impact,
proven outcomes, happy patients

Nura reads the patient's data and decides what care they need. Lumo puts that care in the patient's hand. The EHR extension leaves the record where your team already works. Medsien runs all of it.

Chronic Care Management (CCM) Overview & Benefits

The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) defines chronic conditions as those in which the patient is at significant risk of death, acute exacerbation/decompensation, or functional decline, and are expected to last until the death of the patient.

Learn more

Transitional Care Management (TCM) Overview & Benefits

Transitional Care Management is a program designed to support and track Medicare patients in the 30 days following discharge from a hospital or treatment facility.

Learn more

Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) Overview & Benefits

The Annual Wellness Visit (AWV) is a Medicare specific annual health status check where patients have vitals and health status indicators assessed, to provide an opportunity for earlier support and intervention for chronic conditions or concerns.

Learn more
